profile.description:
Fugu Ultra v1.0 is Sakana AI's multi-agent conductor: it coordinates a pool of expert models on every request and composes their work into one answer, built for hard reasoning, coding, and research. It accepts text and image input with a 1M token context.

Notes:
- Responses can take from a few seconds to a few minutes to complete.
- The full answer arrives at once rather than token by token (ie. streaming is not available), because the model finishes its internal work before it replies.
- Extra High and Max reasoning levels are aliases. 

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
